items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 21:1
items.html: Its phase from below upward is called the Rishayhu of Yeshsut, and the mutual looking of the eyes of Yeshsut, which came out on a screen from the phase of the clothing of, and from the coarseness of, phase two, whose stature reaches Hochma. And its body extended into the king Tifferet, in its lower two thirds, from the Chazeh downward to its end. And it is the phase of Haya of the Neshama of ZA. (p. 522, Item 45)
